<!-- B"H
Boruch Hashem
Blessed is He

Binah gives the endless light a measured vessel and the Awtsmoos creates both measure and meaning; Awtsmoos.com will touch only files whose real responsibilities are proven by inspection before anything starts gleaming.
-->
# Phase One — Theoretical File Surface

Likely areas to inspect before finalizing touches:

- Create-page composition/view modules.
- Prompt view and template modules.
- Assigned-media/reference view modules.
- Composer asset controller/event modules.
- Asset preview/cache modules.
- Generation transport and provider proxy client.
- Late-loaded Director/Create stylesheet loader.
- Existing intuitive/unified body CSS modules.
- Browser smoke tests for intuitive UI, Better V2, assets, Director, legacy behavior.
- Deterministic tests for replacement and API client/mapper/validation.

Possible new small modules if inspection proves responsibility boundaries:

- `CreateMediaPromptBody.js` — one main composition shell only.
- `CreateMediaBoard.js` — assigned image/video/audio presentation only.
- `CreateMediaActions.js` — UI data for add/replace/remove roles only.
- `media-composer.css` — main responsive body geometry.
- `media-board.css` — image wells, preview tiles, drop affordance.
- `media-prompt.css` — prompt integration and contextual helper layout.
- `media-motion.css` — compositor-only focus/hover/reduced-motion effects.
- `media-prompt-smoke.cjs` — body-first UX proof.
- `media-replacement-smoke.cjs` — actual replacement persistence/payload proof if not already covered.

No file is approved for modification until real imports, call sites, line counts, and current production behavior are inspected.
